name: Torst

facts.text: Torst is a level-80 creature with 100,000 health, paired with Hurika on a high ledge of the glacier; the original patrol flight is switched off.
His powerful wings stir swirling eddies of freezing air (five 'eddie' adds), and he roots and casts Cold Snap around him.
Allakhazam lists Torst at level 85 and his drops as griffon mantles; the glacier also holds griffon icewings and chicks.
Swedish torst and Old Norse thorsti mean thirst (to verify).
facts.source: Swedish and Old Norse glossaries, to verify

story: High on the eastern ledge, where the glacier meets the sky, the great griffons of the ice keep their roost. Torst is the cock, a beast of cold feathers whose wings stir the air into freezing eddies that hunt on their own. The Vind Ryttaren, the wind-riders of the island, have tried for a generation to take a chick from his roost and failed. The hrimthursa leave him be. He is no one's servant, only a neighbour with a temper, and his name means thirst.
legend: Torst and Hurika come together. Torst's eddies are adds, kill or avoid them; Hurika throws people off the ledge. Pull them down where it is flat if you can. A 2003 raid of about 60 did it by pulling the bird down.

phases.text: (Torst beats his wings, and the air itself freezes!)

lairEntry: Wind and feathers. Something huge roosts up here.
atmosphere.realmFirstKill: Torst has fallen from the roost of the ice.

loremasterTopic.text: The cock of the griffon roost on the eastern ledge. His wings freeze the air into eddies that hunt on their own. The wind-riders of the island have tried for a generation to steal a chick from him.
